cases.case_label: De novo 5'-truncated L1 at -8 of RPS6KA3 intron 3
cases.mechanism_detail: A de novo 5'-truncated, partially inverted L1 (2.8 kb) at position -8 of intron 3 causes skipping of exon 4, a frameshift and premature stop; the TSD duplicates the acceptor site but neither copy is used.
cases.quote: a de novo insertion of a 5'-truncated LINE-1 element at position -8 of intron 3, which leads to a skipping of exon 4, leading to a shift of the reading frame and a premature stop codon.
